## How to use this page

This question bank is organised by topic. Navigate to the theme most relevant to your evaluation, browse the questions, and copy-paste those that fit your needs. Each question includes:
- The **question text**, ready to use
- **Response options** where applicable
- The **source survey** it is drawn from

Questions are drawn from validated instruments including the **Community Innovation Survey (CIS)**, the **Firms Adoption of Technology Survey (FAT)**, the **World Bank Enterprise Surveys (WBES)**, the **World Management Survey (WMS)**, the **Flash Eurobarometer on SME Digitalisation**, and the **ECB Survey on Access to Finance of Enterprises (SAFE)**. More information on these surveys can be found using the following links: 
- CIS: <https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/microdata/collections-research/community-innovation-survey>
- FAT: <https://microdata.worldbank.org/collections/fat>
- WBES: <https://espanol.enterprisesurveys.org/en/enterprisesurveys>
- WMS: <https://worldmanagementsurvey.org/>
- SAFE: <https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/ecb_surveys/safe/html/index.en.html>

> **Tip:** Adapting a validated question is faster and more reliable than writing one from scratch — and it allows you to benchmark your results against other studies.
